info.name: Calendar HTTP API
info.description: Local Calendar API regression collection. Run folders in order, one iteration. baseUrl defaults to http://localhost:8080. GET date is YYYY-MM-DD in UTC; week is Monday to next Monday, month is first day to next first day, exclusive end. Created fixtures are deleted on a completed run. Lists must return JSON arrays (200), or 204 when empty. Current implementation defects are deliberately reported as failed tests, not accepted. See postman/README.md.

item.name: 04 Invalid requests
item.description: Expected client errors (400). These tests intentionally expose handlers that write the body before WriteHeader and accidentally return 200.
